newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Formosa Fnd shareholders OK Irish listing.
newsitem.headline: Formosa Fnd shareholders OK Irish listing.

text.p: Formosa Growth Fund Ltd said on Friday shareholders at an extraordinary general meeting authorised its plan to apply for a listing on the Irish Stock Exchange, and if accepted, to withdraw its ordinary shares listing on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong.
Formosa Growth Fund said the new listing and withdrawal of listing would both occur before December 31, 1996.
Earlier this month, the fund said the proposed changes on listing arrangements would reduce costs, reduce settlement risks and make it easier for the company to issue further shares.
